Privacy Statement

Please Read Carefully – This contains important information about Privacy

Manulife Financial Corporation and its subsidiaries (collectively called “Manulife” or referred to as “our company”) in this Personal Information Privacy Statement (“Privacy Statement”) are committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information in our care. This Privacy Statement explains our company’s personal information handling practices and applies to any personal information that we obtain about you (directly from you or from third parties) during the application and recruitment process.

We encourage you to read this Privacy Statement and Manulife’s Statement of Corporate Privacy Principles before providing any personal information to us.

We will collect, use, process, store, disclose and access your personal information in accordance with this Privacy Statement, and always in fair and legal ways.

What information we collect about you                       

We only collect personal information about you that we require for the purposes identified below. We may collect any of the following types of personal information:

  • Identifiers such as: name, address, email address, telephone number, date of birth, national identification number (e.g., Social Insurance/Security Number), passport number, fingerprints and signatures;
  • Professional or employment-related information such as: employment history, education information, aptitude test and psychometric assessment results and professional licenses;
  • Information received from background checks, including information provided by third parties;
  • Health information;
  • Other information required for regulatory, legal, and business reasons.

Personal information does not include anonymous or de-identified data.

As part of our application process, we collect some information on a voluntary basis, and this will typically be noted at point of collection. For example, in the case of protected characteristics (namely, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, citizenship and disability status), we collect information voluntarily for the purposes of supporting, attracting, engaging, developing, employing and promoting a diverse workforce, maintaining accurate employment records and administrative processes , and complying with government reporting and other regulatory requirements. When we are required by law to report data, we will not identify any specific individual.

If you do not provide any of the information listed above when requested, or if you request deletion of or withdraw consent regarding this information, we may not be able to achieve the purposes listed below.

How we use your information

We only use your personal information where applicable law permits or requires it in connection with carrying out our application and recruitment process, to comply with a legal obligation applicable to us for our legitimate business interests or the legitimate legal or business interests of third parties, or with your consent if applicable law requires consent.We use your personal information for the following or comparable purposes:

  • To verify your identity and information;
  • To assess your suitability for a position to which you apply (or to inform you about and consider you for other positions for which you may be suited);
  • To communicate with you;
  • To conduct background checks after a conditional offer of employment is made;
  • To support you as an applicant, such as accessibility and accommodation requests;
  • To manage the security and protection of the company, applicants, employees, officers and directors, customers or the public;
  • To ensure adherence to our company’s policies;
  • To understand our current and future employee and human resource needs and/or to improve our application, recruitment or employment processes;
  • To support automated decision making through exams, prescreening evaluations and system processes;
  • For internal investigations and reporting, data analysis, and surveys;
  • For diversity, equity, and inclusion programs and initiatives purposes;
  • To comply with legal and regulatory requirements, such as employment equity and other reporting;
  • To assess conflict of interest issues;
  • For other purposes related to your application and recruitment for employment.

How we access and disclose your information

Your personal information will, from time to time, be:

  • Accessed by and/or disclosed to our company’s employees, contractors and contingent workers globally in the course of performing their duties in relation to your application or the recruitment process;
  • Disclosed to law enforcement or other government agencies, or other third parties as required or permitted by law;
  • Disclosed to third parties who provide services to us, so they can assist us with the application or recruitment process. 

When we disclose your personal information to third party business partners and/or service providers, we require them to protect it in ways that are consistent with our privacy policies and practices and not use it for their own commercial purposes.

Personal information collected by our company is not sold to any third parties.

How we safeguard your information

We take the security of your personal information seriously. We protect your personal information with security safeguards that are appropriate to the sensitivity of the information, and designed to prevent unauthorized access, release, modification, or use.

How long we keep your information

Your personal information will be kept only as long as needed to satisfy the purposes for which it was collected or as required by our records retention policy or allowed by law.

If you are not a successful candidate, your application data, including personal information, will be retained for three years, in accordance with our records retention policy, or for such other duration as required by applicable law.

How we transfer your personal information across borders

Where permitted by applicable law, we may transfer your personal information outside of your home country, and we will ensure a similar degree of protection is afforded to it by implementing one of the following appropriate safeguards:

  • We will transfer your personal information to countries that have been deemed by the applicable government or governing body to provide an adequate level of protection for personal data
  • We will use an agreement in a form approved by the applicable government or governing body to give personal information the same protection it has in your home country.

Your rights

We make all reasonable efforts to ensure that the personal information we collect and store is as correct, complete, and up to date as it needs to be for its intended use.

We will rely on you to give us accurate information and to let us know about any changes.

In certain circumstances and depending on which privacy laws apply, you may have the right to ask to see your personal information, request its correction or deletion, check that it is being lawfully processed, request transfer of your information to another party, or object to or request restriction of its processing. 

In a situation where you have provided consent, you may withdraw such consent. Once we have received notification that you have withdrawn your consent, we will no longer use your information for that purpose, unless we have another legal basis for doing so.

If you would like to exercise your rights in relation to your personal information, you can send a request to hr@manulife.com.

If, during the application or recruitment process, you wish to have your personal information deleted from our systems, please email hr@manulife.com with the subject line "Please remove me from your Applicant Tracking System database".

Inquiries/Contact

If you have any questions or concerns about our privacy practices, or related policies and procedures, please send an email to HRDataPrivacy@Manulife.com.

If you are based in the United Kingdom or the European Economic Area, Manulife Investment Management (Europe) Limited is the controller of your personal information for the purposes of applicable data protection law and so responsible for this Privacy Statement. You have the right to make a complaint at any time to the relevant data protection authority. We would, however, appreciate the chance to deal with your concerns before you approach the data protection authority. You can contact the Data Protection Officer by sending an email to DPO_Europe@Manulifeam.com.

Acknowledgement

I authorize Manulife, John Hancock, and their respective affiliates, subsidiaries, service providers and agents to process, collect, store, use, disclose and transfer my information (both inside and outside my jurisdiction), including my personal information, for the purposes identified above.

I certify that the personal information I have and will provide during my application for employment and the recruitment process is truthful, accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any misrepresentation I make or incorrect personal information I provide may disqualify me from employment consideration, result in administrative and/or plan/program delays, and/or result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of my employment with Manulife with cause.
